name: Seco S.p.A.
summary: Seco S.p.A., a technology company, develops and delivers cutting-edge solutions for the digitization of industrial products and processes in Italy, Germany, the United States, the Asia-Pacific, and internationally. The company offers range of embedded computing hardware for OEMs, including computer-on-module, single board computer, AI- Optimized hardware, embedded PCs, and human machine interface products.
